description: Edits an image from 1–2 source images with optional prompt (Wan 2.5 Image-to-Image).

prompt.description: Prompt describing the elements and visual features. Supports English and Chinese. Empty prompts are accepted.

dispatch_mode.description: Dispatch mode. "sync" (default) blocks until the job completes. "async" submits the job and returns immediately with a job ID; poll completion via `job_get`. Named `dispatch_mode` (not bare `mode`) so it never collides with provider-specific `mode` knobs (freepik DynamicCombo, pixverse motion mode, meshy pose mode, …).

negative_prompt.description: Negative prompt describing what to avoid.

watermark.description: Whether to add an AI-generated watermark to the result.
